<!DOCTYPE html>

<title>Send your clients a gallery, not a Drive folder</title>
<!--
  ✉️  SUGGESTED EMAIL SUBJECT:
      Send your clients a gallery, not a Drive folder
  -->
<!--
  GALLEROO · HTML email template (English)
  • Table-based, inline styles → works in Gmail, Apple Mail, Outlook, etc.
  • IMPORTANT: before sending, replace the image src (assets/...) with

    they will not load for recipients.

<style>

  body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%!important;background:#070F0D;}
  table{border-collapse:collapse;}

  a{text-decoration:none;}
  .px{font-family:'Mulish','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;}

    .h1{font-size:27px!important;line-height:1.12!important;}

</style>

<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:#070F0D;">

                <p class="px" style="margin:0;font-family:'Mulish','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#5FC8B0;">✓ You've been unsubscribed</p>
                <p class="px" style="margin:5px 0 0;font-family:'Mulish','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:#9AACA7;">You will no longer receive emails from Galleroo. You can re-subscribe anytime at YOUR-DOMAIN.com.</p>

<script>
  function galllerooUnsub(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var link = document.getElementById('unsubLink');
    var done = document.getElementById('unsubDone');
    if(link) link.style.display = 'none';
    if(done) done.style.display = 'block';
  }
</script>
